name: Idempotent Eikonal Ray Marching
aliases: Fixed-Point Projection for Real-Time Implicit Surface Rendering
definition: A ray-surface intersection method that formulates intersection as a curvature-accelerated contraction operator Phit on the Eikonal distance field to solve the computational stall of sphere tracing near grazing angles and silhouette edges.
summary: Idempotent Eikonal Ray Marching is a ray-surface intersection method that solves grazing angle stalls by selectively activating second-order Halley contraction within silhouette horizons while using Lipschitz advances in open space.
